title: Network Engineer
description:
Network Engineer 
 About Primarch Skills Primarch Skills Pvt. Ltd. is a purpose-driven organization committed to enabling sustainable livelihoods through large-scale skill development and income generation initiatives. We work closely with government bodies and public sector institutions to design and deliver outcome-oriented programs that empower marginalized and underserved communities across India. With a strong focus on inclusivity, employability, and entrepreneurship, Primarch Skills implements end-to-end solutions from community mobilization and training delivery to placement, self-employment, and post-training support. Our programs are aligned with national and state skill development missions, ensuring compliance, transparency, and measurable impact. At Primarch Skills, we believe that skills are the foundation of economic dignity. By equipping beneficiaries with market-relevant competencies and livelihood opportunities, we strive to create long-term socio-economic transformation and contribute meaningfully to nation-building. 
 Position Details Position Title: Network Engineer Number of Positions: 01 Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan Reporting To: Administration Manager / Senior Leadership Employment Type: Full-time, in-office Experience Required: 2-4 Years 
 Educational Qualifications Bachelors Degree Candidates with a Bachelors Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Computer Applications (BCA / B.Sc. IT), Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech.), or related fields may apply. Candidates with a Diploma in Computer / Hardware & Networking and relevant experience may also apply. Masters Degree (Preferred/Advantageous) Candidates with an MCA, M.Sc. IT, M.Tech., or a related Masters Degree will be preferred. Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+ / A+, Fortinet NSE, or Microsoft 365 will be an added advantage. Additional preference will be given to candidates possessing: Hands-on experience in setting up and fixing routers, switches, firewalls, and Wi-Fi. Good knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, and VPN. Hands-on experience in desktop, laptop, and printer support. Experience managing Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace (users, email, licences, and access). Understanding of cyber security basics, data backup, and access control. Experience supporting multi-location or field-based teams. Experience in development sector, skilling, education, or project-based organisations. 
 Relevant Work Experience Candidates with 2–4 years of experience in networking, IT support, system administration, or IT infrastructure are eligible to apply. Preference will be given to candidates with demonstrated experience in: Setting up and maintaining office networks, Wi-Fi, and internet connections. Configuring routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs. Fixing network and connectivity issues. Installing, configuring, and fixing laptops, desktops, and printers. Installing and updating operating systems and software. Managing user accounts, email, and licences on Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. Antivirus, data backup, and basic IT security. Helpdesk support and coordination with IT vendors. 
 Role Overview The Network Engineer will look after the complete IT set-up of Primarch Skills and its sister concerns and subsidiaries. Around half of the role is about the network (office networks, Wi-Fi, internet, firewalls, and VPNs) and the other half is about IT systems and support (laptops, software, email, security, backups, and user support). The role acts as the first point of contact for all technology needs of office staff as well as project and field teams. We are looking for a hands-on person with strong technical basics, who keeps good records, takes security seriously, and can handle many requests at the same time. The selected candidate will work closely with the administration, HR, finance, and programme teams to make sure systems are running, data is safe and backed up, and everyone has the tools they need to do their work. 
 Roles & Responsibilities A. Network (approx. 50% of the role) Network Set-Up & Configuration Set up and maintain the network at offices, project locations, and training centres. Plan and set up LAN and Wi-Fi networks, including cabling and rack work. Configure routers, switches, VLANs, and wireless access points. Manage IP addresses, DHCP, and DNS, and keep device firmware up to date. Keep separate networks for staff, guests, and devices such as CCTV. Firewall & Network Security Keep the network safe from unauthorised access and threats. Set up and manage firewall rules, web filtering, and access controls. Check firewall logs and alerts regularly, and act on anything unusual. Review firewall rules and open ports from time to time and close any gaps. VPN & Multi-Site Connectivity Connect offices, project locations, and remote staff securely. Set up and support VPNs between offices and for staff working remotely. Make sure all locations can reliably access internal systems and government portals. Internet & ISP Management Make sure every location has reliable internet. Coordinate with internet service providers for new connections, upgrades, and outages. Set up backup internet lines that take over automatically when the main line fails. Keep an eye on bandwidth usage and control it where needed. Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting Keep the network running smoothly. Use monitoring tools to track uptime, speed, and device health. Fix network, Wi-Fi, VPN, and slow internet issues quickly, on site or remotely. Find the cause of repeated issues and fix them permanently. Keep backups of router, switch, and firewall settings so they can be restored quickly. CCTV & Biometric Device Networks Set up and support the network for CCTV cameras, NVRs, and biometric attendance devices at offices and training centres, and make sure they stay online and secure. B. IT Systems & Support (approx. 50% of the role) IT Hardware & Asset Management Look after all IT equipment from purchase to disposal. Set up and maintain laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, projectors, and video conferencing equipment. Keep an IT asset register with details of each device, who it is issued to, and its warranty. Issue devices to employees and collect them back when they leave. Arrange repairs, warranty claims, and safe disposal of old devices after wiping data. Software & Licence Management Make sure all systems run licensed and updated software. Install and set up operating systems and business software on new devices. Keep operating systems and software updated with the latest security patches. Keep a record of software licences (Microsoft 365, Tally, antivirus, and others) and track renewals. Email & Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace Manage the organisation’s email and collaboration tools. Create, change, and remove user accounts, mailboxes, and groups. Manage access to shared drives, folders, and Teams. Turn on multi-factor authentication and password rules. Manage the domain, email settings, and SSL certificate renewals. Helpdesk & User Support Be the first point of contact for all IT issues. Fix hardware, software, email, printer, and connectivity issues, on site or remotely. Log and track all issues in a ticketing tool or tracker and close them on time. Escalate complex issues to vendors and follow up until they are resolved. Cyber Security & Data Backup Keep systems and data safe. Install and monitor antivirus on all devices. Give users only the access they need, and review access regularly. Take regular backups of important data (Tally, HR, MIS, and project records) and test that they can be restored. Make staff aware of phishing, passwords, and safe handling of data, including beneficiary data. Report and escalate security incidents as required, including under CERT-In guidelines. Joining & Exit Support Work with HR to give new joiners their laptop, email ID, Wi-Fi, and system access on day one. When someone leaves, remove their access on time, collect their devices, and save their data as per policy. Field & Project Tech Support Support project and field teams with laptops, tablets, biometric devices, internet devices, and access to government and internal portals. Help district and centre-level staff remotely when they face device or internet issues. Vendors, Purchase & AMC Collect quotations for IT and network purchases, coordinate with vendors, manage AMCs and warranties, and track renewals of domains, firewall licences, software, and internet connections. IT Policies & Documentation Prepare and update IT policies and procedures. Keep network diagrams, IP address lists, asset and licence records, vendor contacts, and admin passwords up to date and stored securely, and support IT audits. Reporting & Updates Share regular IT and network updates covering issues, uptime, assets, renewals, security incidents, backups, and IT spend with the reporting manager. Additional Project Responsibilities Take up any other work assigned by the reporting manager or Senior Leadership in line with organisational needs, including assignments for Primarch Skills and its sister concerns and subsidiaries. 
 Skills Networking: Good knowledge of IP addressing, VLANs, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and VPN. Router, Switch & Firewall Set-Up: Ability to configure and fix routers, switches, firewalls, and Wi-Fi. Hardware Support: Ability to set up, fix, and maintain laptops, desktops, printers, and other devices. Operating Systems & Software: Good working knowledge of Windows 10/11, MS Office, and common business software. Email & Cloud Administration: Ability to manage users, mailboxes, licences, and access on Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace. IT Security & Backup: Knowledge of antivirus, patching, multi-factor authentication, access control, and data backup. Documentation: Keeps accurate records of network diagrams, IP lists, assets, and licences. Communication: Ability to explain technical issues in simple terms and support non-technical users patiently. Confidentiality & Professionalism: Handles admin access, passwords, and sensitive data with care and integrity. 
 Competencies Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for keeping systems and the network running. Service Orientation: Responds to user requests quickly and politely, and focuses on solving the issue. Analytical Thinking: Finds the root cause of issues instead of applying repeated quick fixes. Problem Solving: Solves technical issues independently and knows when to escalate. Security Mindset: Keeps security and data protection in mind in every set-up and change. Collaboration & Teamwork: Works well with administration, HR, finance, programme teams, and vendors. Process Orientation: Follows set procedures and keeps proper records of all changes. Adaptability & Learning: Keeps up with new tools and technologies and puts them to good use. 
 Tools & Technical Proficiency Mandatory Routers, managed switches, and Wi-Fi access points. Firewall / UTM platforms (e.g., Fortinet, Sophos, or similar). Windows 10/11 and MS Office. Microsoft 365 Admin Center or Google Workspace Admin Console. Antivirus / endpoint protection tools. Remote support tools (e.g., AnyDesk, TeamViewer, Quick Assist). Network troubleshooting tools (e.g., ping, traceroute, Wireshark). MS Excel for asset, IP, licence, and issue tracking. Desired Network monitoring tools (e.g., PRTG, Zabbix, or similar). Networking brands such as Cisco, Ubiquiti, MikroTik, or Aruba. Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Intune, or similar device management tools. Backup and NAS solutions (e.g., Synology, Veeam, cloud backup). IT helpdesk / ticketing tools (e.g., Freshservice, Zoho Desk, GLPI). Basic scripting (PowerShell or Python) for routine tasks. Tally installation and multi-user set-up. CCTV / NVR and biometric attendance systems. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is technically strong, organised, and service-minded, with hands-on experience in both networking and day-to-day IT support for a small to mid-sized organisation. Experience supporting multiple locations or field-based teams will be a strong plus. We will also give preference to candidates who take security seriously, keep good records, take ownership, and stay calm while handling many requests in a deadline-driven environment. 
 Travel & Mobility Requirements Mainly office-based role in Jaipur. Occasional travel to project offices, training centres, or vendor locations for set-up, support, or audits. Flexibility to handle urgent issues or planned maintenance outside regular working hours when needed. 
 What You Gain From This Role This role offers the chance to own and shape the IT and network set-up of a mission-driven organisation working on large-scale livelihood and skilling programmes. You will gain hands-on exposure to networking, IT systems, cloud tools, cyber security, field tech support, and vendor management. The role is a strong platform to grow in network engineering, IT infrastructure, and IT management. 
 Application Process Interested candidates may apply through the following link: https://forms.gle/zNQrmSEKTHfrLY2z7 Shortlisted candidates will be invited for preliminary screening and interviews. 
 Diversity, Equality & Inclusion Primarch Skills Pvt. Ltd. is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We encourage applications from candidates across different social, cultural, educational, and professional backgrounds. We believe diversity strengthens problem-solving, innovation, and impact, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity and fair treatment throughout the recruitment and employment process. 
 Background Verification & Integrity Checks Selected candidates may undergo background verification and reference checks through relevant authorities or authorised agencies. Candidates applying for this role should: Provide accurate educational and professional information. Be willing to submit documents required for verification processes, if requested. Demonstrate professional integrity, accountability, and a strong commitment to ethical conduct.

Key Skills: System Support,IT Helpdesk,ISP Management,Network Support,Internet,Firewall Management,microsoft365admin,Network engineering

title: Technology Support Engineer
description:
Project Role : Technology Support Engineer

 Project Role Description : Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution. 

 Must have skills : Network Infrastructures

 Good To Have Skills: : SD-WAN Operations
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

 Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education
The Network Engineer is responsible for supporting, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network infrastructure, including routing, switching, and wireless environments. The role involves working in medium to large-scale networking environments, providing L2/L3 level support, executing changes, and ensuring network stability and performance. 1. Network Operations & Support
Perform day-to-day administration of LAN, WAN, and WLAN infrastructure.
Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity using network tools.
Provide L2/L3 troubleshooting for incidents across routing, switching, and wireless domains.
2. Routing & Switching (Cisco,Juniper)
Configure and troubleshoot: 
VLANs, STP, EtherChannel
Layer 3 routing (OSPF, BGP, static routing)
Support Cisco and Juniper devices (routers, switches, SD-WAN if applicable). 
3. Wireless Networking (Cisco / Aruba)
Manage and troubleshoot wireless networks: 
Aruba Controllers, Access Points, Aruba Central
Cisco Wireless Controllers (WLC) and APs
Handle SSID configuration, RF optimization, authentication issues, and roaming problems.
Ensure wireless coverage and redundancy for enterprise environments. 
4. Incident, Problem & Change Management
Handle incidents, service requests, and problem tickets within SLA timelines.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues.
Execute standard and emergency network changes as per change management process.
5. Network Infrastructure & Implementation
Support deployment and configuration of new network devices.
Assist in network upgrades, migrations, and transformations (e.g., Aruba to Juniper or Cisco upgrades). 
Validate network connectivity and performance post-implementation.
6. Documentation & Compliance
Develop and maintain network documentation, SOPs, and runbooks.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security and operational policies.
Update knowledge base and share best practices across teams. 
Required Skills & Technical Expertise
Core Networking
Strong understanding of OSI/TCP-IP model
Routing protocols: OSPF, BGP
Switching technologies: VLAN, STP, VTP, trunking
Vendor Technologies
Cisco: Routing, Switching, Wireless, DNAC (preferred)
Juniper: JUNOS CLI, Routing, Switching
Aruba: WLAN Controllers, Aruba Central, Access Points
Wireless Technologies
802.11 protocols (a/b/g/n/ac/ax)
RF fundamentals and troubleshooting
AAA (RADIUS, TACACS), WLAN security
Tools (Good to Have)
Monitoring tools like SolarWinds, Splunk, or similar
Network automation basics (Python/Ansible - optional)
Qualifications
Bachelor s Degree in Computer Science / IT / Electronics or equivalent
3-4 years of experience in enterprise network operations/support role
Certifications (Preferred)
Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
Juniper JNCIA / JNCIS (preferred)
Aruba Certified Mobility Associate (ACMA) - optional

 Qualification 15 years full time education
